title: WkDoctor: System Physician (T3 ref)
desc: T3 reference tier. Implementation details of the Physician-vs-Reaper design. History of WMI overhead reduction and dual-trigger policy.
steps: WMI OVERHEAD REDUCTION: previous versions performed raw 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process' on every check. v2.0 integrates with 'wktasklist -Json' to share its 9-second cache, dramatically reducing WMI scan storms during emergency triggers.

DUAL-TRIGGER POLICY: user requirement 2026-06-06 moved from RAM-only to 'CPU or RAM > 60%' trigger. This aligns wkdoctor with the wkharness PreToolUse guards. Policy: recover until BOTH are below 40%.

ADMIN EYE INTEGRATION: moved from 'Start-Process -Verb RunAs' to 'wkappbot --sudo exec' pattern. This leverages the Eye's persistent elevation, allowing wkdoctor to apply Defender exclusions without repeated UAC popups for the same session.
DYNAMIC SANCTUARY: hardcoded paths (D:\GitHub) were removed in favor of relative detection (2 levels up from bin/). This ensures portability of the sanctuary across different developer environments.
author: gemini
